title: When opening a task or card, it should not auto-advance for the first step.

runs.prompt:
Task: When opening a task or card, it should not auto-advance for the first step.

When I open a task, it should not auto-advance just by opening it. Once I start it, it should auto-advance the stages in it. If auto-advance is enabled, I mean by default it is enabled, but if it is turned off, it should not auto-advance. But auto-advance only works when going from any task which is not the first task. You cannot auto-advance to the first task.
 Thank you.

Fit check: single bugfix, one screen + tests → stays in **Bugfix** flow. Fixed.

**Root cause** — `TaskDetail` had mount-time effect calling `automate()` for any task with undone stages. Open card → stage 1 ran. Switch bound to `automating` (live-run state), so "auto-advance off" unrepresentable.

**Fix** (`src/app/features/task.jsx`, `views.jsx`):
- Deleted mount-time auto-start effect. Opening runs nothing, ever.
- New `stageDone(end, stageId)` — one shared completion path. Chains only if: setting on, run came back `done`, not last stage, work remains, no other stage live.
- `automate(from = 0)` slices stage list; `stageDone` passes **next** index → auto-advance can't reach back into first (or any unrun earlier) stage. Server unchanged — already resumes from first incomplete in whatever list it gets.
- Auto-advance now real per-task setting, default **on**, persisted `localStorage` `bridza.autoAdvance.<pipe>/<task>` (same idiom as `bridza.taskView`/`railHidden`). Switch reads/writes it; label still shows "⚡ Auto-advancing…" during live chain.
- `StageRunner` → `onDone(end, def.id)`.

**Shared path check** — `StageRunner` = only stage runner in the screen; both routes (classic `Stage` card + Inspector/Canvas/Chat via `runnerFor`) now point at `stageDone`. Revise/Stop call `onDone()` argless → refresh only, no chain. `App.jsx` `onDone`s are modals, unrelated.

**Tests** — `task-auto.test.jsx` rewritten, 12 tests: open never-started/half-done task starts nothing; run first stage by hand → chains `["build"]` only; middle-stage run in 3-stage task → chains `["review"]`, never back to unrun first; no chain past last stage / on `failed` / while another stage live; setting off → stage runs, nothing chains, off survives reopen; log-survives-navigation kept.

```
vitest run  →  9 files, 205 passed
```
New tests vs pre-fix code: **8/12 fail** → they bite.

E2E specs asserting old auto-start updated to press ▸ Run first (`e2e/ux-views.spec.js`, `e2e/app.spec.js`). Playwright not run — needs live dev server + browsers, unavailable here. Lint: `src/app` excluded by eslint config.

Output doc: `.bridza/pipelines/engineering/when-opening-a-task-or-card-it-should/fix/outputs/fix.md`. Changes left uncommitted.

One behavior note worth your call: switch is now pure preference — it no longer kicks off a run. Starting a task = ▸ Run on its first stage. If you want a one-click "run everything" button back, say so and I'll add it as an explicit action.

**Verdict: approve.** Merge into `main` will be clean.

**Root cause fixed at source.** Mount-time `autoStartedRef` effect deleted, not patched. `automate` now reachable from exactly one call site (`stageDone` → `automate(next)`) — grep-confirmed, no other caller in `src/`. Forward-only enforced by `stageObjs.slice(from)`, not by trusting the server to decline. All 4 root causes in repro.md addressed, incl. the persisted setting.

**Sibling callers clean.** Traced every `onDone` consumer after signature change `onDone()` → `onDone(end, def.id)`:
- ↺ Revise + ⏹ Stop pass no args → `end` undefined → refresh, chain nothing. Correct.
- `runnerFor` (Inspector/Canvas/Chat) and the `Stage` card converge on the same `stageDone` — one rule, one place.
- `App.jsx` `onDone` props are the pipeline/task *modals*, unrelated.

**Regression test bites — verified, not trusted.** Checked out pre-fix `task.jsx`/`views.jsx` from `main`, kept new tests: **8 failed / 4 passed**, incl. headline "starts NO run at all". Post-fix 12/12. The 4 passing pre-fix are the #13 guards, correctly unchanged. Source restored from HEAD; no source modification left behind. Full suite: **205/205**.

**Merge:** `merge-tree` → clean tree SHA, no conflicts. `main` is 44 ahead but **zero** of those touch `src/` or `e2e/` — all `.bridza` bookkeeping. No semantic drift either.

4 advisory findings, none blocking. Most substantive: **the switch no longer starts anything**, and nothing replaced it as a "resume after stop" affordance — repro.md:21 explicitly allowed flipping it as an explicit start. Defensible (arguably safer) reading of "should not auto start at any steps", and recoverable via ▸ Run, but it's a deliberate narrowing that fix.md doesn't flag. Worth recording so it isn't later re-filed as a bug. Also: the setting is `localStorage`, so "off" won't follow the task across browsers/machines — repro suggested task-level state; the chosen idiom matches `bridza.taskView` and the blast radius is now small.

Two caveats on my coverage: Playwright wasn't run (needs live server + browsers), so e2e is statically verified only — I did confirm the `/Run (stage|again)/` regex matches `▸ Run stage`/`▸ Run again` and that the first incomplete stage card is open on arrival, so the button is reachable.
